findings.evidence: The statement mentions only `Ω : Opens E`, `g : E → ℂ`, `ν : Measure E` and `c : NNReal`. Grep finds no other `ofFun ... smul_measure` lemma in TauCeti.
findings.fix: Make it a public `Distribution.ofFun_smul_measure` in the Tau Ceti file that holds the other facts about `Distribution.ofFun` (e.g. near `Distribution.isLocallySobolevAt_ofFun_iff_exists_wkp`), and import it here.
findings.issue: `ofFun_smul_measure` (scaling the measure by a constant scales `Distribution.ofFun` by that constant) is a general fact about distributions with no manifold content. It is `private` inside a Sobolev vector-bundle file. The PR description says Mathlib lacks it, so this hides a reusable fact.

findings.evidence: l.233 `chartComponent_ofSection _ _ _ (fun _ _ ↦ by rw [coe_baseSetChart]) hs v`; l.256–257 `hsl.locallyIntegrableOn_target (𝒸 i) (baseSetChart_source_subset _ _) fun _ _ ↦ by rw [coe_baseSetChart]`; l.301–302 has the same term.
findings.fix: Add a private lemma `locallyIntegrableOn_target_center (hs) (i) : LocallyIntegrableOn (FirstJetBundle.localRep 𝓘(ℝ, E) F s (A.center i)) (𝒸 i).target (Module.finBasis ℝ E).addHaar`, or a private lemma for the chart-agreement condition. Use it in all three places.
findings.issue: The same side-condition argument is copied three times: `fun _ _ ↦ by rw [coe_baseSetChart]` shows `baseSetChart` at the centre matches the preferred chart. It appears in `chartComponent_center` (l.233), `toBundleDistribution_injective` (l.256–257) and `memSobolev_toBundleDistribution` (l.301–302). The last two also repeat `hsl.locallyIntegrableOn_target (𝒸 i) (baseSetChart_source_subset _ _) ...`.

summary: A general lemma about distributions (scaling the measure scales `Distribution.ofFun`) is hidden as a private helper in a vector-bundle file, and the same chart side-condition argument is repeated three times instead of being factored out.
